coverage: Selected official public releases and 2026 Powerball jackpot recap through 3 October 2026. Incomplete coverage, not a population-level win rate.
coordinate_method: Approximate published city/region reference points. Not addresses or verified physical shop coordinates. For MyLotto, coordinates denote reported player area, not a ticket sales outlet.
online_warning: MyLotto entries show reported winner area, NOT physical ticket purchase location. No retailer precision is implied.
